_what: SKEPTIC re-run of qal/skip4. 12 chain rows re-run from scratch in qal/skip4v under PYMS_VAE_CACHE=.../vae_cache_skeptic, plus one new independent control (cellfloor.cir). Decks from a byte copy of skip4/skip.py; ALL extraction by qal/skip4v/verify.py off the raw .prn (independent of skip4/extract.py and of the .mt0 .measure lines). Pre-registration: SKEPTIC_PREREG.json, written before any deck existed.
reproduction_verdict: REPRODUCES. Every number I re-measured agrees with qal/skip4/RESULTS.json to the printed digit.

NEW_INDEPENDENT_CONTROL_cellfloor._what: One committed cell (pMOS 1.12u supply+bulk on its own rail, nMOS 0.74u, CL 2 fF) on an IDEAL stiff rail that STEPS at t=2 ps, with an IDEAL DC gate. Strictly kinder than any chain. Deck qal/skip4v/cellfloor.cir.
NEW_INDEPENDENT_CONTROL_cellfloor.consequence: SCHEDULE-FREE REFUTATION. At the MEASURED depth-1 delivered rail (0.6441 V) the cell needs 164.3 ps to reach 90% with a perfect rail and a perfect gate. No beat period at or below 160 ps exists at that rail for reasons that have nothing to do with which bank powers which. At the depth-2 rail (0.4486 V) the figure is 1578.8 ps. The brief's t_settle ~58 ps belongs to a 0.7138 V rail (I measure 111.2 ps there with a stiff rail); it does not exist at the rail a chain delivers.

overlap_finding.concurrency_that_does_the_speed_work: each bank's OWN charging hop overlaps its OWN evaluation window, because boundary = c_k + T and T < t_hop + t_settle. MEASURED at T=120: 103.7/120 = 86.4% of the beat (skip bank3), 104.6/120 = 87.2% (adj bank2). PRESENT IN BOTH SCHEMES, TO THE SAME DEGREE. Skipping adds none of it.
overlap_finding.cross_bank_overlap: ZERO. Consecutive banks' evaluation windows TILE: skip [200,320] [320,440] [440,560]. My interval scan finds no hop conduction interval overlapping any OTHER bank's evaluation window (the single hit is an artefact of a head bank having no charge instant).
overlap_finding.mechanism_needs_the_OPPOSITE_of_overlap: the proposal's correctness argument ('bank 2 has ALREADY settled') is a SEQUENCING requirement. The schedule meets it with EXACTLY ZERO margin: bank 3's acceptance boundary is 320.0 ps and its data source bank 2's drain gate begins rising at 318.0 ps.
overlap_finding.schedule_collision_check_DERIVED: adj at T=60 charges and drains the same bank at once (hop1 charges bank2 over [200.0,304.6], hop2 drains bank2 at 260.0; hop2 charges bank3 over [260.0,373.6], hop3 drains it at 320.0). skip has no collision at any T. CONFIRMED.

instrument_MEASURED.adj_T60_probe_zero_moved: +7.39 ps (hop1) and +10.67 ps (hop2) between the isolated probe and the real deck -- the probe-then-cut protocol itself breaks down in the collided row.
instrument_MEASURED.stranded_energy_check: 0.5*L*I^2 at 286.109 uA = 0.614 fJ and at 254.223 uA = 0.485 fJ -- reproduces the identity residual exactly. The instrument is self-consistent; the schedule is not.

corrections_to_the_report: A3's cliff clause: the report labels the hold test 'THE HOLD PASSES'. A3 as pre-registered requires the held rail to stay above the 0.60 V cliff. MEASURED: at the headline T=120 the held bank-3 rail goes 0.6106 -> 0.5905 V, i.e. the hold itself carries it 9.5 mV BELOW the cliff; same at T=60 (0.5877 V). It passes at T >= 160 (min 0.6104 V). So the hold passes on droop and on A3's second clause and FAILS A3's cliff clause at the headline point. Yardstick note: comparing the 20.2 mV hold droop with the -597 mV hop droop makes the hold look harmless; against the 10.6 mV of cliff margin actually available at T=120 it is 1.9x the margin.
'+7 to +10 points of PULL-DOWN at every beat period' is +4.34 points at T=60 (96.63 vs 92.29). The row is in the report's own table; the summary sentence overstates the floor.
P2 ('the limiting device at the deepest SKIP stage is NOT the pull-down') holds at the deepest stage but NOT at stage 4: skip_T300 stage 4 is pull-down limited (67.62% pull-down vs 71.21% pull-up).

Per-gate discipline is vacuous in this fixture: MEASURED intra-class spread is exactly 0.000e+00 percentage points in every bank of every one of the 12 rows. All 8 gates are two electrically identical classes of 4 (same sizes, same rail, symmetric pattern), so 'per-gate, never aggregated' yields two numbers per stage, not eight. The campaign's 'average hides a dead gate' trap cannot be exercised by this deck. Not a defect in the arithmetic; a limit on what it can catch.

Boundary-rule asymmetry: boundary = min(c_k + T, d_k - EDGE) puts every ADJACENT hop-charged bank 2 ps earlier than the skip banks (adjacent has d_k = c_k + T, skip has c_k + 2T). MEASURED cost to adjacent: +1.10 to +1.65 points of worst-gate settling. Removing it widens adjacent's depth-1 advantage at T=120 from 5.0 to 7.7 points, i.e. it biases in SKIP's favour and makes the report's own 'P1 was partly wrong' correction stronger.

Rail residue: the report's '2.00-beat rail life' is a SCHEDULE fact (DERIVED from the PWL phases), correct as such. MEASURED, a drained bank does not reach 0 V: skip rail2 settles at 0.118-0.138 V and rail3 at 0.094 V after their own drains, adj rail2 at 0.025 V. Charge left behind, not delivered.

premise_check.is_the_adjacent_successor_actually_corru: YES, MEASURED. adj T=120: bank 2's pull-down gate drive (bank 1's HIGH output) falls 1.1602 -> 0.4944 V across bank 2's own evaluation window (-57.4%), ending 29.5 mV BELOW Vtn = 0.5239 V; bank 1's rail at that instant is 0.0187 V. At T=300 it is 1.1602 -> 0.4104 V (-64.6%). The premise applies.
premise_check.does_skipping_repair_it: YES, MEASURED. skip T=120: bank 3's pull-down gate drive holds 1.1986 -> 1.1185 V (-6.7%), overdrive +0.5946 V, and its pull-down output is -0.0037 V vs adjacent's 0.0599 V on a comparable rail (0.6441 vs 0.6406 V) -- a real 63 mV repair, not a normalisation artefact. Depth-1 pull-down 96.63-100.75% (skip) vs 90.65-93.51% (adj).
premise_check.but: the repaired term was never the binding one. In the ADJACENT control the limiting device is the PULL-UP at every stage and every beat period (23.10-32.49% at depth 1, 23.33-25.67% at depth 2, 32.11-32.98% at depth 3) while the pull-down it repairs stands at 90.65-93.51% at depth 1. Skipping fixes a real defect that is not the one that fails.
